name: Seo Bin
source: A handsome, singing homeless man. He gets along with the manager well, because he likes free things and food. He's like a father to his siblings, but he's often childish with the manager, so it makes you feel like he's actually young. He might seem to be a little bit dull, though he speaks deep things at times.
